s04945D.name: OW process 4: Mario walks along the path
summary: Overworld process [$13D9] = 4 (entry 4 of PtrsLong04857D). Moves the current player ([$0DD6] = 0 Mario, 4 Luigi) from tile to tile.
Destination [$0DC7]/[$0DC9] is the corner of the next path piece. The speed is split between the axes so the walk is straight: major axis
speed from DATA_049414 (set [$1B80]), minor = major * minor distance / major distance; 8.8 fixed point, fraction kept in [$13D5]/[$13D7].
On arrival it picks the next direction (0 up, 2 down, 4 left, 6 right, never reversing) from the tile map $7EC800 or the hardcoded path
([$1B78]), rejects empty and non-walkable (>= $87) tiles, sets the sound, the exit flags in [$1EA2] and the walking animation [$1F13].
Level tile reached (tile step already begun, [$1444] set): writes the level name and advances to process 5. Special tiles start a submap
transition (process $0A).
$049831: shared tail, centers the BG1/BG2 scroll on the player (main map only), clamped to DATA_049416/DATA_04941A. $04983F: entry for the camera only.

OW_TilePos_Calc.name: Calculate OW tile position; process $0C
summary: OW_TilePos_Calc: converts tile coordinates to an offset into the 32x32 tile map arrays ($7EC800 tiles, $7ED000 level numbers).
The map is 2 screens wide and 2 high: offset = (X & $F) + ((X & $10) << 4) + ((Y << 4) & $FF) + (Y & $10 ? $200 : 0) + (submap ? $400 : 0).
Parameters: [$00] = tile X, [$02] = tile Y (16-bit), X = player index (0 Mario, 1 Luigi). Returns: [$04] = offset.
$0498C6 (separate routine): overworld process $0C. Mario rises 1 pixel every second frame until [$1F19] low = $78, then process 0 and the
game is saved (CODE_009BC9). Probably the end-of-game or cutscene finish.

s049903.name: Set level exit flag from tile exit data
summary: Called by overworld process 2 (CODE_048F87). If [$0DD5] is a positive step count, takes the player's tile and reads a 2-bit field of the
byte at $7ED800 (shift count from DATA_049060), then sets the matching direction bit (DATA_04941E: 8 up, 4 down, 2 left, 1 right)
in the level flags [$1EA2 + level number of the tile]. Also stores the player's tile coordinates in [$1F1F]/[$1F21].

s049964.name: Table: submap transition trigger positions
summary: 14 entries of 5 bytes: Y position (word), X position (word), submap number. Read by CODE_049A24 with the matching entries of
DATA_0499AA (destination) and DATA_0499F0 (destination tile).

s0499AA.name: Table: submap transition destinations
summary: 14 entries of 5 bytes: new Y position (word), new X position (word), new submap number.

s0499F0.name: Table: submap transition destination tiles
summary: 14 entries of 2 bytes: tile Y, tile X of the destination, stored in [$1F21] and [$1F1F].

s049A0C.name: Table: submap scroll boundaries
summary: Six entries of 4 bytes, for submaps 1 to 6: BG1/BG2 X scroll (word), Y scroll (word). Indexed by (submap - 1) * 4 in CODE_049A93.

s049A24.name: Submap transition: warp and set scroll
summary: CODE_049A24: looks the player's Y position, X position and submap up in the 14 entries of DATA_049964. On a match it moves the player to
the destination position, tile coordinates and submap [$13C3] from DATA_0499AA/AC/AE and DATA_0499F0/F1.
$049A93: stores [$13C3] as the player's submap [$1F11] and loads the BG1/BG2 scroll from DATA_049A0C (submap 0: updates the
camera from the player position via $04983F instead). Called from CODE_04856F and CODE_04DB5C.
